notes.title: Patch 1.02 – Correction in Japanese Translation (Rin's Route)
notes.notes:
We have fixed a translation issue in the Japanese version of Rin's route.  
We sincerely thank the players who pointed it out, and we apologize for any confusion or inconvenience caused.  
Your continued support is greatly appreciated.
